description: Fixed equal-weight linear pool (probability space) of the stored, write-once predictions of se1_lgbm_mm, se17_lgbm_mm_900k and se18_lgbm_all_b0 for the same capture (DESIGN_V1 section 47). No fit, no training rows, no refit cost. Members chosen by schedule (the three LightGBM challengers due their first promotion read on 2026-11-04), not by score; weights fixed at 1/3 without any look at outcomes. A target is pooled only when every member carries it. Inherits any member's embargo (none today). Development until its own prospective score; no edge claim.
